entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Dammit! Of COURSE they spot us now...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we wanna head back, we'll hafta go[n]through this guy... Time to make a path!
entries.uk: Щоб повернутися, доведеться пройти[n]через цього типа... Проб'ємо дорогу!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What was the deal with that explosion?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like the impact detonated it[n]somehow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, shit... there're Shadows that can[n]do that!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maybe we can make it work for us[n]by blowing it up when we want to.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look, a treasure chest! Let's take[n]whatever is in there too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's okay. Hey, Joker, do you think[n]we can ambush it from here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It ought to go the same as when you hide[n]and jump on an enemy. Give it a shot.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I didn't realize even Shadows beg for their[n]lives—that's actually kind of surprising...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shadows have emotions too, you know.[n]Of course they'll be afraid if you corner[n]them like that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It might be worth purposely creating such[n]situations to get them begging for their lives.
